title: Argentinian Beef Empanadas
description: A classic Argentinian dish, these empanadas are filled with tender beef and spices, perfect for a snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: Beef, finely chopped
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cook to at least 160°F (71°C)

instructions: In a large skillet, heat the spiced oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chopped beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
In a separate bowl, combine the flour and warm water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon or two of the beef mixture onto one half of the circle.
Fold the other half over to form a half-circle, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with the warm water and egg mixture.
Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Cook the empanadas for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
